instruction: Create a plain text signature in Thunderbird: "Robert Taylor" on the first line and "Marketing Director" on the second.

metadata.explanation: Simple two-line signature with name and job title. Matches original task complexity exactly.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric. Signature text verified to match regex escape requirements for special characters (dots, plus signs).

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification: Instruction requires 'plain text signature' but evaluator only checks signature text content (mail.identity.id1.htmlSigText)

Signature text content check is correct: Regex pattern 'Robert Taylor\nMarketing Director' with method 're.S' correctly matches the two-line text

Optionally add verification for mail.identity.id1.attach_signature to ensure signature is enabled
